text:
Cymabay Therapeutics (CBAY) Shareholder Baker Bros Advisors LP Has Lifted Position by $13.60 Million as Valuation Rose; Canadian Natl Ry Co (CNI) Holder Callahan Advisors Raised Position 
March 22, 2018 - By Michael Collier 
Julian Baker increased its stake in Cymabay Therapeutics Inc. (CBAY) by 131.6% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Baker Bros Advisors Lp bought 1.70 million shares as the company’s stock rose 21.05% with the market. The hedge fund run by Julian Baker held 2.99M shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $24.11 million, up from 1.29 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Baker Bros Advisors Lp who had been investing in Cymabay Therapeutics Inc. for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $746.48M market cap company. The stock decreased 5.13% or $0.69   $12.76. About 549,302 shares traded. Cymabay Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ:CBAY) has risen 69.26%   uptrending. It has outperformed by 52.56% the S&P500. 
Callahan Advisors Llc increased its stake in Canadian Natl Ry Co (CNI) by 21.53% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Callahan Advisors Llc bought 8,457 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.48% with the market. The institutional investor held 47,744 shares of the railroads company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $3.96M, up from 39,287 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Callahan Advisors Llc who had been investing in Canadian Natl Ry Co for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $53.18 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 2.35% or $1.73   $71.9. About 1.27 million shares traded. Canadian National Railway Company (NYSE:CNI) has risen 30.03%   uptrending. It has outperformed by 13.33% the S&P500. 
Callahan Advisors Llc, which manages about $289.56M and $475.59M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Allegiance Bancshare by 9,820 shares to 50,618 shares, valued at $1.86 million in 2017Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Cvs Health Corporation (NYSE:CVS) by 8,153 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 26,367 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Computer Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL). 
Among 27 analysts covering Canadian National Railway ( NYSE:CNI ), 10 have Buy rating, 3 Sell and 14 Hold. Therefore 37% are positive. Canadian National Railway had 70 analyst reports since July 21, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. TD Securities downgraded the stock to “Hold” rating in Tuesday, April 26 report. Stifel Nicolaus maintained the shares of CNI in report on Wednesday, October 26 with “Hold” rating. The rating was maintained by Barclays Capital with “Equal Weight” on Wednesday, October 28. The stock has “Buy” rating by Cowen & Co on Friday, September 29. The rating was maintained by Credit Suisse on Thursday, July 13 with “Hold”. The company was initiated on Thursday, May 19 by CLSA. On Wednesday, January 24 the stock rating was maintained by Credit Suisse with “Neutral”. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Tuesday, September 8 by TD Securities. Atlantic Securities initiated Canadian National Railway Company (NYSE:CNI) on Thursday, August 11 with “Buy” rating. The firm has “Neutral” rating by Nomura given on Tuesday, April 26. 
Among 8 analysts covering Cymabay Therapeutics Inc ( NASDAQ:CBAY ), 8 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 0 Hold. Therefore 100% are positive. Piper Jaffray maintained Cymabay Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ:CBAY) rating on Tuesday, July 25. Piper Jaffray has “Buy” rating and $1200 target. The rating was maintained by H.C. Wainwright on Wednesday, January 24 with “Buy”. Roth Capital initiated Cymabay Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ:CBAY) on Thursday, January 25 with “Buy” rating.
